why_desc: Premium is the same app and the same code as the free version, with the limits lifted. What follows is true on Free and Premium alike.
why1_desc: The client, the server and the VpnHood! ENGINE behind them are all published on GitHub, and the project has been audited by two independent security firms. You can read the code instead of taking our word for it.
why2_desc: Cloak Mode makes VPN traffic resemble ordinary HTTPS traffic, which helps it through networks that block VPNs outright. How well it works depends on what the network inspects, and no connection is guaranteed to stay unblocked.
why3_title: A free tier that is really free
why3_desc: No account, no time limit, and no cap on traffic or bandwidth. It is funded by ads, so it is not available where ads are not served. Premium removes the ads and works everywhere.
compare_desc: Every plan above unlocks the same list. The free app keeps unlimited traffic, unlimited bandwidth and split tunneling; Premium adds the locations, the speed, the extra devices and an app without ads.
note_free_availability: The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in China or in other countries where ads are not served. Premium has no such limit.
